_about: The PUBLIC ROUTE title button joins the always-open room under this code (Godot room_state.gd PUBLIC_CODE, public_route.gd). The public route has no player host: a server process (last_route --dedicated-host PUBLC) holds it and every runner joins as a guest. Until that process is up, client_host_fallback lets the first runner open the room as a stand-in, and when that runner leaves the others hand the room over (the lowest session id opens it, handover_step_seconds apart per place in line; a runner tries for handover_grace_seconds, and waits handover_dedicated_seconds for a server process that left before a stand-in may open). Set client_host_fallback to false once the server process holds the route: no client then ever opens the room. difficulty is the one difficulty of the public route; nobody chooses it. The code is five letters like any room code. heartbeat_seconds is the directory heartbeat of the public room: the directory forgets a public entry 15 s after its last beat, so it is capped at 10 s (a heartbeat request times out after 4 s; private rooms keep 20 s). The code is matched exactly, like the server does.
